en: The image is an old sepia-toned postcard featuring a group of children and adults dressed in traditional attire standing by a waterfront. The background shows buildings, trees, a lamp post, and boats on the water. The scene is lively and indicative of everyday life. There is a postal stamp and handwritten text on the right side of the postcard. Printed text at the bottom reads 'ALEXANDRIE. - Enfants...'.
